spec.scope: Boss-held DEF debuff — reduces boss DEF in the (final ATK − boss DEF) damage formula, so it lifts the WHOLE TEAM's per-hit damage, not just ludmilla's. Not a self/ally stat.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 10 (wall-clock seconds, stated literally). NOT rounds. Cycle math: 120-round SMG magazine at ~20/s ≈ 6.0s fire + 187f ≈ 3.12s reload ≈ 9.1s per lastBullet — so 10s duration gives near-continuous uptime with each reapply landing ~0.9s before lapse.
spec.triggerIdentity: lastBullet (per-magazine, fires at the final round of each magazine / reload start). No FB gate, no everyN, no status gate.
spec.targetSet: enemy (the boss). Per harness note, boss-held debuffs emit buffApply with casterIdx===null AND targetIdx===null — filter by stat+value.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two plausible misreads: (a) trigger drift — shotFired or interval instead of lastBullet, giving ~permanent uptime from t=0.05s instead of first apply at ~6s and reapplies keyed to reloads; (b) scope drift — encoding as an inert self/enemy stat the engine never reads, so the line silently moves ZERO damage despite being the kit's main offensive contribution.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Run controlComp with ludmilla; collect buffApply events for the DEF-down stat at value 8.4 with casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null. Assert (1) the count equals the number of ludmilla reload events (±1 for fight-end truncation) and each apply frame is within one shot-frame of a ludmilla reload/last-bullet frame — RED under shotFired (thousands of applies) or interval; (2) first apply is at ~6s (first magazine end), NOT frame 0 — RED under passive/interval-t=0; (3) A/B: totals of the OTHER units (e.g. crown, helm) are strictly HIGHER with the block present than with withPatchedOverride('ludmilla', o => strip the DEF▼ effect) — RED under any encoding where boss DEF reduction is not actually wired into the damage formula.
spec.inertness: Must NOT apply to any ally (no buffApply with a non-null ally targetIdx for this stat); must NOT change ludmilla's own fire cadence, shot count, or reload timing; the apply cadence must not change inside vs outside Full Burst.

spec.scope: Boss ATK debuff — purely defensive (reduces incoming boss damage). The v1 boss deals no modeled damage, so this moves nothing offensively.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 10 if encoded; irrelevant if listed in unmodeled.
spec.triggerIdentity: Same lastBullet trigger as the DEF▼ line (same ■ header).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Mis-encoding as atkPct ▼ on ALLIES or on SELF (a −8.4% ATK team debuff), which would wrongly depress the whole board. Second misread: conflating it with the DEF▼ line into a single damageTakenPct boss debuff, inventing team damage the kit does not grant.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Assert NO buffApply with stat atkPct and a negative/8.4 value ever targets a non-null ally/self targetIdx; assert no damageTakenPct buffApply exists anywhere in the run (the kit has no Damage Taken ▲ line). A/B with the line stripped: every unit's total is IDENTICAL to the digit.
spec.inertness: Must move zero damage for all five units; must appear verbatim in override.unmodeled.skill1 if not encoded.

spec.scope: Taunt/aggro on all enemies — positioning/defensive. No damage stat. Boss movement follows the MEASURED range script (a hard constraint); a taunt must not perturb it.
spec.durationSemantics: 15.09 sec if ever encoded; N/A as unmodeled.
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter (literal 'when entering Full Burst' — fires on ANY team FB, not only rotations ludmilla bursts). Note this is the correct trigger identity even though the line is unmodeled — record it so a future consumer doesn't misfile it as burstCast.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Inventing a mechanical effect for the taunt — e.g. modeling it as boss-range/position manipulation or as a Damage Taken ▲ boss debuff ('Attract' pattern-matching to an offensive status).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: A/B with skill2 fully stripped via withPatchedOverride: all five units' totals identical, and the fullBurstStart/fullBurstEnd event timeline (count + frames) identical — RED if the taunt was given any damage or rotation side-effect.
spec.inertness: Zero damage movement; zero rotation/FB-count movement; verbatim line present in override.unmodeled.skill2.

spec.scope: SELF-targeted damage-reduction — defensive. CRITICAL SCOPE TRAP: this is the mirror image of the taxonomy's 'Damage Taken ▲ is a boss debuff' rule. Here the arrow is ▼ and the target is SELF; it is NOT the boss damageTakenPct channel.
spec.durationSemantics: 15 sec if encoded; N/A as unmodeled.
spec.nearestWrongModel: THE expected shared-prior misread for this kit: encoding as damageTakenPct on the ENEMY. With the engine convention 'positive = boss takes more', a naive sign-carry produces either a −57.86% boss debuff (collapsing the entire team's damage by more than half during every FB) or a spurious +57.86% boss debuff (massively over-crediting the team). Either direction is catastrophic and easy to write from the words 'Damage Taken'.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Assert the event log contains ZERO buffApply with stat damageTakenPct in the whole run (kit has no boss Damage-Taken line); A/B with skill2 stripped shows byte-identical totals for all five units — RED under either sign of the boss-debuff misread, which moves every unit's FB-window damage by a huge factor.
spec.inertness: No damageTakenPct events; no damage movement anywhere; verbatim line in override.unmodeled.skill2.

spec.scope: Instant burst-cast damage, % of ludmilla's final ATK. Multi-target line vs a SINGLE partless boss: exactly ONE enemy exists, so exactly ONE hit of 163.1% per cast — the 10-target count is target-capacity, not a hit multiplier.
spec.durationSemantics: Instant (one damage instance per cast). No duration.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — dealt when ludmilla casts her own Burst I (cd 20s, so once per rotation she wins the B1 slot). Burst-cast/instant damage is always FB-exempt (lands before the FB window opens) and riders take no range bonus by engine default.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Multiplying by the target count — 10 hits (or atkPct 1631) against the single boss, a clean 10× over-credit of her burst bucket. Secondary misreads: letting the hit take the +50% FB major (fbMajorApplied true) or the +30% range bonus, or granting it core.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: For each ludmilla burstCast event, assert EXACTLY ONE damage event in bucket 'burst' with srcSlot 'burst' on that frame, with mult consistent with 163.1% of her final ATK (not 1631%), fbMajorApplied === false, rangeApplied === false, and no core contribution. Count of these damage events === count of her burstCast events. RED under the 10-hit misread (10 events or 10× mult) and under FB/range inclusion.
spec.inertness: Zero burst-bucket damage on rotations where ludmilla does NOT cast (if another B1 wins the slot); no damage events of this kind outside burst-cast frames.

spec.scope: Ally DEF ▲ — offensively inert (defPct does not feed any damage path), but per the tandem rule DEF/HP/heal/shield lines are ENCODED anyway as a future consumer feed, not silently dropped. The 'above 50% HP' gate is trivially always-true at scope (no unit ever takes damage), so no gate primitive is needed — but the condition must be recorded.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (a line inside her OWN burst block with a condition clause, not a team-FB clause) — fires only on rotations ludmilla actually casts B1. NOT fullBurstEnter.
spec.targetSet: allies (kit says 'all allies' — verify whether the encoding includes self; 'all allies' conventionally includes the caster unless 'except self' is stated, so allies with excludeSelf absent).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Keying to fullBurstEnter instead of burstCast — diverges the moment another Burst-I unit is in the team (liter is the fixture's B1!), applying the buff on rotations ludmilla never cast. Secondary: encoding as atkPct 12.93 (DEF misread as ATK — a real +12.93% team ATK buff, large board movement).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Assert buffApply events with stat defPct value 12.93 appear ONLY on frames where a ludmilla burstCast event fired, one per ally target — RED under fullBurstEnter (applies would appear on every FB including liter-cast rotations). Assert zero buffApply with stat atkPct value 12.93 anywhere. A/B with the line stripped: all totals identical (proves the inert-encoding claim).
spec.inertness: Must move zero damage for all five units (defPct is inert); must NOT fire on Full Bursts whose B1 cast was liter's.

loadBearingSet: skill1:DEF ▼ 8.4% for 10 sec (boss DEF shave — team-wide damage)
burst:Deals 163.1% of final ATK as damage

skill2: Attract: Taunt all enemies for 15.09 sec.

notes: Three things the driver must reconcile. (1) FIXTURE HAZARD — ludmilla is Burst I, but controlComp(carry) seats the carry in the B3 slot with liter as B1: a same-stage collision. Her burstCast damage and burst DEF▲ only fire on rotations SHE wins B1 (first-ready in-window), so the tests must first assert her burstCast events actually occur in the chosen comp (or build a comp without a competing B1); a test that passes with zero ludmilla casts vacuously greens every burst assertion. (2) The kit's ONLY offensive lever besides the 163.1% nuke is the boss DEF ▼ 8.4% — the tests must prove it moves TEAMMATE totals (the A/B in the skill1 spec), because an encoding that emits the buffApply but never reaches the damage formula's boss-DEF term passes event-count assertions while being damage-inert; if the engine has no boss-DEF-reduction path, that is a GAP to declare, not a line to silently drop. (3) EXPECTED SHARED-PRIOR MISREAD: 'Damage Taken ▼ 57.86%' on SELF pattern-matches the well-known boss damageTakenPct channel — the zero-damageTakenPct-events assertion is the cheapest guard against a sign-or-target error that would move the board by tens of percent. Duration semantics are benign here (all seconds, no round counts); the interesting cadence fact is that the 9.1s magazine cycle (6.0s fire + 3.12s reload) vs the 10s debuff duration gives near-permanent but not gapless DEF▼ uptime — an interval/passive mis-trigger would erase the ~6s debuff-free opening window, which the first-apply-frame assertion catches.
